jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Sr. Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery is responsible for bringing the next generation of guest experiences to life across MSC Cruises' new class of ships.
Working closely with the Product Innovation team, this role transforms approved concepts into fully realized onboard experiences, ensuring they are operationally executable, commercially successful, and aligned with the MSC Cruises brand.
Leading the development and delivery of end-to-end guest journeys, service concepts, and onboard experiences, the Sr. Director ensures every experience is launch-ready from ship design and operational planning to crew delivery and guest activation.
The role also plays a key part in defining how new experiences are presented to guests, partnering with internal teams to shape compelling storytelling, positioning, and go-to-market strategies that maximize guest engagement and commercial impact.
As a trusted partner to senior leadership, the Sr. Director regularly presents progress, recommendations, and delivery strategies to executive stakeholders, including the CEO and Chairman, ensuring alignment from concept approval through successful launch.

Your Impact

Experience Development & Delivery

-
Lead the end-to-end development and delivery of new guest experiences, from approved concept through ship launch.

-
Translate approved concepts into guest journeys, service models, operational requirements, and launch plans.

-
Ensure every experience remains true to the original vision while being operationally feasible, commercially successful, and aligned with MSC Cruises' brand standards.

Guest Experience Excellence

-
Champion guest-centric experiences that combine hospitality, storytelling, service excellence, and commercial performance.

-
Design memorable end-to-end guest journeys that create emotional engagement and enhance guest satisfaction.

-
Apply industry best practices and continuous innovation to elevate onboard experiences across the fleet.

Cross-Functional Leadership

-
Lead collaboration across Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, architects, designers, and external partners to successfully deliver new guest experiences.

-
Ensure alignment between ship design, construction milestones, operational readiness, and launch activities.

-
Manage stakeholder expectations, priorities, risks, dependencies, and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

Project & Delivery Management

-
Oversee project plans, budgets, timelines, milestones, risks, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.

-
Support the SVP with budget oversight, executive reporting, strategic recommendations, and delivery governance.

-
Ensure projects are properly planned, resourced, and delivered on time, within scope, and in line with business objectives.

Executive Communication

-
Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations and project updates for senior leadership, including the CEO and Chairman.

-
Clearly communicate delivery progress, key decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations.

-
Support executive decision-making with data-driven insights, operational considerations, and guest experience perspectives.

Team Leadership

-
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of guest experience professionals.

-
Build capabilities in guest journey design, hospitality delivery, stakeholder management, project execution, and operational integration.

-
Foster a collaborative, accountable, innovative, and guest-first culture while developing future leadership talent.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

-
Define, monitor, and report KPIs related to launch readiness, guest satisfaction, operational adoption, experience quality, and commercial performance.

-
Lead post-launch evaluations, capture lessons learned, and implement continuous improvements to strengthen future experience delivery.

-
Drive a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across all guest experience development activities.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

- 12+ years of experience in designing and delivering physical, in-space guest experiences within hospitality, cruise ships, resorts, themed entertainment, or similar service-driven environments, with a clear focus on onboard or on-site experiences rather than digital products.

- Proven track record of leading large-scale, guest-facing physical experience projects from concept through implementation in complex operational environments such as ships, hotels, or resorts.

- Strong understanding of physical guest experience design, hospitality operations, service excellence, and in-person customer journey development within built environments.

- Demonstrated ability to translate strategic concepts into operationally executable, tangible experiences and launch plans within physical spaces.

- Experienced leader with a proven ability to build, develop, and inspire high-performing, cross-functional teams.

- Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership and Board-level audiences.

- Strong commercial, financial, and analytical mindset, balancing guest experience, operational feasibility, timelines, and investment.

- Experience collaborating with designers, architects, creative agencies, and operational teams to deliver immersive, physical environments and experiences.

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams) and presentation tools to develop compelling concepts and executive communications focused on physical experience delivery.

- Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

- Willingness to travel internationally up to 30%.

Your Essentials

-

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Il Sr. Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery è responsabile di portare la prossima generazione di esperienze ospiti in vita attraverso la nuova classe di navi di MSC Crociere.
Lavorando a stretto contatto con il team Product Innovation, questo ruolo trasforma i concetti approvati in esperienze a bordo completamente realizzate, garantendo che siano eseguibili operativamente, commercialmente di successo e allineati con il marchio MSC Cruises.
Conducendo lo sviluppo e la consegna di viaggi ospiti end-to-end, concetti di servizio e esperienze a bordo, il Direttore Sr. assicura che ogni esperienza sia pronta al lancio dalla progettazione navale e dalla pianificazione operativa alla consegna dell'equipaggio e all'attivazione degli ospiti.
Il ruolo svolge anche un ruolo chiave nella definizione di come vengono presentate nuove esperienze agli ospiti, collaborando con i team interni per modellare interessanti strategie di storytelling, posizionamento e go-to-market che massimizzano il coinvolgimento degli ospiti e l'impatto commerciale.
In qualità di partner di fiducia per la leadership senior, il Direttore Sr. presenta regolarmente progressi, raccomandazioni e strategie di consegna per le parti interessate esecutive, tra cui il CEO e il Presidente, garantendo l'allineamento dall'approvazione del concetto attraverso il lancio di successo.

Il tuo impatto

Sviluppo e consegna dell'esperienza

-
Condurre lo sviluppo end-to-end e la consegna di nuove esperienze ospiti, dal concetto approvato attraverso il lancio della nave.

-
Traduci concetti approvati in viaggi ospiti, modelli di servizio, requisiti operativi e piani di lancio.

-
Assicurarsi che ogni esperienza rimanga fedele alla visione originale, pur essendo operativamente fattibile, commercialmente di successo, e allineato con gli standard del marchio MSC Crociere.

Esperienza degli ospiti

-
Esperienze incentrate sugli ospiti campione che combinano ospitalità, storytelling, eccellenza del servizio e performance commerciali.

-
Progettare memorabili viaggi ospiti end-to-end che creano impegno emotivo e migliorare la soddisfazione degli ospiti.

-
Applicare le migliori pratiche del settore e l'innovazione continua per elevare esperienze a bordo in tutta la flotta.

Leadership trasversale

-
Leader collaborazione tra Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, architetti, designer e partner esterni per offrire con successo nuove esperienze agli ospiti.

-
Assicurare l'allineamento tra progettazione navale, pietre miliari di costruzione, disponibilità operativa e attività di lancio.

-
Gestisci le aspettative, le priorità, i rischi, le dipendenze e il processo decisionale in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto.

Gestione del progetto e della consegna

-
Superare i piani di progetto, i budget, le linee temporali, le pietre miliari, i rischi e i materiali di consegna attraverso molteplici iniziative.

-
Sostenere il SVP con la supervisione del budget, la segnalazione executive, le raccomandazioni strategiche e la governance della consegna.

-
Assicurare che i progetti siano adeguatamente pianificati, informatizzati e consegnati in tempo, entro i limiti e in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali.

Comunicazione

-
Preparare e fornire presentazioni ad alto impatto e aggiornamenti di progetto per la leadership senior, tra cui il CEO e il Presidente.

-
Comunica chiaramente i progressi della consegna, le decisioni chiave, i rischi, i trade-off e le raccomandazioni.

-
Sostenere il processo decisionale esecutivo con intuizioni basate sui dati, considerazioni operative e prospettive di esperienza degli ospiti.

Leadership del team

-
Guidare, allenare e sviluppare un team altamente performante di professionisti dell'esperienza degli ospiti.

-
Costruire le capacità nella progettazione del viaggio degli ospiti, la consegna dell'ospitalità, la gestione degli stakeholder, l'esecuzione del progetto e l'integrazione operativa.

-
Promuovere una cultura collaborativa, responsabile, innovativa e guest-first, sviluppando il futuro talento di leadership.

Prestazioni e miglioramento continuo

-
Definire, monitorare e segnalare i KPI relativi alla disponibilità di lancio, alla soddisfazione degli ospiti, all'adozione operativa, alla qualità dell'esperienza e alle prestazioni commerciali.

-
Condurre valutazioni post-lancio, acquisire lezioni apprese e implementare miglioramenti continui per rafforzare la consegna futura esperienza.

-
Guidare una cultura di eccellenza, innovazione e miglioramento continuo in tutte le attività di sviluppo dell'esperienza degli ospiti.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Corso di laurea richiesto; MBA o altro grado avanzato preferito.

- 12+ anni di esperienza nella progettazione e fornitura di esperienze fisiche e in-spaziali negli ambienti dell'ospitalità, delle navi da crociera, dei resort, dell'intrattenimento a tema o di simili ambienti orientati al servizio, con una chiara attenzione alle esperienze onboard o on-site piuttosto che ai prodotti digitali.

- Rilevato record di grandi progetti di esperienza fisica orientati agli ospiti dal concetto attraverso l'implementazione in ambienti operativi complessi come navi, hotel o resort.

- Forte comprensione del design dell'esperienza fisica degli ospiti, le operazioni di ospitalità, l'eccellenza del servizio e lo sviluppo del viaggio di cliente in persona all'interno di ambienti costruiti.

- Dimostrata capacità di tradurre concetti strategici in esperienze attuabili, tangibili e di lanciare piani all'interno di spazi fisici.

- Leader esperto con una comprovata capacità di costruire, sviluppare e ispirare team altamente performanti e interfunzionali.

- Ottima gestione degli stakeholder, influenza e capacità di comunicazione, con esperienza che presenta alla leadership esecutiva e al pubblico di livello del Consiglio.

- Forte mentalità commerciale, finanziaria e analitica, bilanciando l'esperienza degli ospiti, fattibilità operativa, tempestività e investimenti.

- Esperienza di collaborazione con designer, architetti, agenzie creative e team operativi per offrire ambienti e esperienze immersive, fisiche.

- Proficienza con Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams) e strumenti di presentazione per sviluppare concetti convincenti e comunicazioni esecutive focalizzate sulla consegna di esperienze fisiche.

- Fluente in inglese; lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

- Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale fino al 30%.

I tuoi essenziali

-

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Dein Zweck

Der Senior Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery ist dafür verantwortlich, die nächste Generation von Gästeerlebnissen in der neuen Klasse von MSC Cruises zum Leben zu erwecken.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktinnovationsteam verwandelt diese Rolle genehmigte Konzepte in vollständig realisierte Onboard-Erlebnisse und stellt sicher, dass sie operativ ausführbar, kommerziell erfolgreich und auf die Marke MSC Cruises ausgerichtet sind.
Als Leiter der Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von End-to-End-Gästereisen, Servicekonzepten und Onboard-Erlebnissen stellt der Senior Director sicher, dass jede Erfahrung vom Schiffsdesign und der Betriebsplanung bis hin zur Auslieferung der Besatzung und der Aktivierung der Gäste startbereit ist.
Die Rolle spielt auch eine wichtige Rolle bei der Definition, wie neue Erfahrungen den Gästen präsentiert werden, und arbeitet mit internen Teams zusammen, um überzeugende Storytelling-, Positionierungs- und Go-to-Market-Strategien zu gestalten, die das Engagement der Gäste und die kommerzielle Wirkung maximieren.
Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner der Geschäftsleitung präsentiert der Senior Director regelmäßig Fortschritt, Empfehlungen und Lieferstrategien für die geschäftsführenden Stakeholder, einschließlich des CEO und des Chairman, um die Abstimmung von der Konzeptgenehmigung bis zum erfolgreichen Start sicherzustellen.

Ihre Wirkung

Erfahrung Entwicklung & Lieferung

-
Führen Sie die End-to-End-Entwicklung und Bereitstellung neuer Gästeerlebnisse, vom genehmigten Konzept bis zum Schiffsstart.

-
Übersetzen Sie genehmigte Konzepte in Gästereisen, Servicemodelle, Betriebsanforderungen und Startpläne.

-
Stellen Sie sicher, dass jede Erfahrung der ursprünglichen Vision treu bleibt und gleichzeitig operativ machbar, kommerziell erfolgreich und auf die Markenstandards von MSC Cruises ausgerichtet ist.

Guest Experience Exzellenz

-
Champion gastorientierte Erlebnisse, die Gastfreundschaft, Storytelling, Service Excellence und kommerzielle Leistung kombinieren.

-
Entwerfen Sie unvergessliche End-to-End-Gästereisen, die emotionales Engagement schaffen und die Gästezufriedenheit verbessern.

-
Wenden Sie branchenweit bewährte Verfahren und kontinuierliche Innovationen an, um die Erfahrung an Bord in der gesamten Flotte zu verbessern.

Funktionale Führung

-
Führen Sie die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, Architekten, Designern und externen Partnern, um erfolgreich neue Gästeerlebnisse zu liefern.

-
Gewährleistung der Abstimmung zwischen Schiffsentwurf, Baumeilensteinen, Einsatzbereitschaft und Startaktivitäten.

-
Verwalten Sie Erwartungen, Prioritäten, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Entscheidungsfindung während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus.

Projekt- und Liefermanagement

-
Überwachen Sie Projektpläne, Budgets, Zeitpläne, Meilensteine, Risiken und Ergebnisse in mehreren Initiativen.

-
Unterstützen Sie den SVP mit Budgetaufsicht, Executive Reporting, strategischen Empfehlungen und Delivery Governance.

-
Stellen Sie sicher, dass Projekte ordnungsgemäß geplant, mit Ressourcen ausgestattet und pünktlich, in ihrem Umfang und in Übereinstimmung mit den Geschäftszielen geliefert werden.

Exekutivkommunikation

-
Bereiten und liefern Sie wirkungsvolle Präsentationen und Projektaktualisierungen für Führungskräfte, einschließlich CEO und Chairman.

-
Lieferfortschritte, wichtige Entscheidungen, Risiken, Kompromisse und Empfehlungen klar kommunizieren.

-
Unterstützen Sie die Entscheidungsfindung von Führungskräften mit datengesteuerten Erkenntnissen, operativen Überlegungen und Perspektiven für das Gasterlebnis.

Teamleitung

-
Führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team von Gasterlebnis-Profis.

-
Aufbau von Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Guest Journey Design, Hospitality Delivery, Stakeholder Management, Projektdurchführung und operative Integration.

-
Fördern Sie eine kollaborative, rechenschaftspflichtige, innovative und gastfreundliche Kultur und entwickeln Sie zukünftige Führungstalente.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

-
Definieren, überwachen und melden Sie KPIs in Bezug auf Startbereitschaft, Gästezufriedenheit, operative Annahme, Erfahrungsqualität und kommerzielle Leistung.

-
Führen Sie Bewertungen nach dem Start, erfassen Sie die gewonnenen Erkenntnisse und implementieren Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen, um die Bereitstellung zukünftiger Erfahrungen zu stärken.

-
Förderung einer Kultur der Exzellenz, Innovation und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung bei allen Aktivitäten zur Entwicklung von Gästeerlebnissen.

Deine Reise bisher

- Bachelor-Abschluss erforderlich; MBA oder andere fortgeschrittene Grad bevorzugt.

- 12+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Bereitstellung von physischen Gästeerlebnissen im Weltraum in Gastgewerbe, Kreuzfahrtschiffen, Resorts, Themenunterhaltung oder ähnlichen serviceorientierten Umgebungen, mit einem klaren Fokus auf Onboard- oder On-Site-Erlebnissen anstelle digitaler Produkte.

- Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz führender großer, gastorientierter physischer Erfahrungsprojekte vom Konzept bis zur Umsetzung in komplexen Betriebsumgebungen wie Schiffen, Hotels oder Resorts.

- Starkes Verständnis des physischen Gasterlebnisdesigns, des Gastgewerbes, der Servicequalität und der persönlichen Entwicklung der Customer Journey in gebauten Umgebungen.

- Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, strategische Konzepte in operativ ausführbare, greifbare Erfahrungen zu übersetzen und Pläne in physischen Räumen zu starten.

- Erfahrene Führungskraft mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, leistungsstarke, funktionsübergreifende Teams aufzubauen, zu entwickeln und zu inspirieren.

- Ausgezeichnetes Stakeholder-Management, Einflussnahme und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit Erfahrung in der Führungskräfte- und Vorstandsebene.

- Starke kommerzielle, finanzielle und analytische Denkweise, ausgewogenes Gästeerlebnis, operative Machbarkeit, Zeitpläne und Investitionen.

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Designern, Architekten, Kreativagenturen und operativen Teams, um immersive, physische Umgebungen und Erlebnisse zu liefern.

- Kenntnisse mit Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams) und Präsentationstools zur Entwicklung überzeugender Konzepte und Executive Communications, die sich auf die Bereitstellung physischer Erlebnisse konzentrieren.

- Fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

- Bereitschaft, international bis zu 30% zu reisen.

Ihre Essentials

-

Unser Engagement

Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und ermächtigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute, um Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen überschreitet und etwas Bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

Votre but

Le Sr. Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery est chargé d'animer la prochaine génération d'expériences d'invités à travers la nouvelle classe de navires de MSC Cruises.
En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe d'innovation produit, ce rôle transforme les concepts approuvés en expériences embarquées pleinement réalisées, en s'assurant qu'ils sont opérationnelment exécutables, réussis commercialement et alignés avec la marque MSC Cruises.
Dirigant l'élaboration et la prestation de voyages de bout en bout, de concepts de service et d'expériences à bord, le directeur s'assure que chaque expérience est prête à être lancée, de la conception et de la planification opérationnelle du navire à la livraison de l'équipage et à l'activation des invités.
Le rôle joue également un rôle clé dans la définition de la façon dont de nouvelles expériences sont présentées aux invités, en s'associant à des équipes internes pour façonner des stratégies convaincantes de narration, de positionnement et de mise en marché qui maximisent l'engagement des clients et leur impact commercial.
En tant que partenaire de confiance de la haute direction, le directeur principal présente régulièrement les progrès, les recommandations et les stratégies d'exécution aux intervenants exécutifs, y compris le PDG et le président, en assurant l'harmonisation entre l'approbation du concept et le lancement réussi.

Votre impact

Développement et prestation de l'expérience

-
Diriger le développement de bout en bout et la livraison de nouvelles expériences d'invités, du concept approuvé au lancement de navires.

-
Traduire les concepts approuvés en voyages d'invités, modèles de service, exigences opérationnelles et plans de lancement.

-
Assurez-vous que chaque expérience demeure fidèle à la vision initiale tout en étant opérationnellement réalisable, commercialement réussie et alignée sur les normes de marque de MSC Cruises.

Expérience des invités Excellence

-
Expériences centrées sur les invités, qui combinent l'hospitalité, la narration, l'excellence du service et la performance commerciale.

-
Concevez des voyages de bout en bout mémorables qui créent un engagement émotionnel et améliorent la satisfaction des clients.

-
Appliquer les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie et l'innovation continue pour rehausser l'expérience à bord de la flotte.

Leadership interfonctionnel

-
Diriger la collaboration entre Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, architectes, designers et partenaires externes pour offrir avec succès de nouvelles expériences clients.

-

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a commercially driven and digitally fluent Marketing & Media Manager to lead digital & paid media delivery across multiple markets out of our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.
The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with operational excellence, has deep expertise in paid media and digital performance marketing, and understands the nuances of luxury consumer behaviour across diverse global audiences.

Your Impact

1.    Local Media / Marketing Leadership
•    Depending on the size and staffing of the markets in your scope, act as either the local digital media lead, local media lead or local marketing lead.
•    Ensure media campaigns drive brand strategy and align with global standards, while  reflecting local audience behaviour, seasonal demand patterns, language requirements, and cultural nuances.
•    Partner with local sales and marketing teams to support market-specific business and commercial objectives, and with global marketing and media teams to ensure strategic and executional brand consistency.

2.    Digital Campaign Delivery
•    Lead the end-to-end delivery of digital marketing campaigns across multiple markets, ensuring timely execution, consistency, with all placements and asset adaptations meeting luxury brand standards
•    Coordinate with creative, content, CRM, ecommerce, and digital teams to ensure seamless campaign integration and customer journey alignment.

3.    Paid Media Strategy & Performance
•    Develop & execute local paid media strategies across multiple markets.
•    Manage local agency, platforms and media partner relationships.

4.    Measurement & performance analysis

Own the integrated measurement of media across the marketing funnel. Monitor and analyse performance and optimize investments to drive brand awareness, revenue growth, customer acquisition, and direct bookings, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement, including reports and presentations for senior leadership.

5.    Media thought leadership & innovation

Own the innovation plan across channels. Identify the latest media industry developments, recommending test & learn plans to integrate the relevant areas to Explora journey’s media strategy.

6.    Build media literacy

Step-change media knowledge in markets across departments to enhance media planning capabilities and excellence in delivery.

7.    Budget management

Own the global media budget planning, spending and stewardship, including agency/vendor management

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

- 15+ years of client side roles in global and local media including planning, ATL/BTL and directly running digital media

- Strong maketing knowledge

- Outstanding luxury media understanding: in-depth knowledge of offline and digital media, the interdependencies between paid, owned and earned media, as well as luxury media specifics

- Proven ability to roll-up your sleeves and execute with excellence

- Track record of managing agencies, platforms and media partners and building effective partnerships

Your Essentials

- Strategic and innovative critical thinker.

- Structured, well organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects, thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment.

- Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to navigate a matrix organisation. Effectively organize teams to deliver business outcomes.

- Proven analytical skills with proficiency in media tools and platforms

- Strong preference for prior experience in the luxury or luxury hospitality/travel industry. A personal passion for luxury travel and global mindset.

- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving media industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un Marketing & Media Manager commercialmente guidato e digitalmente fluente per condurre la distribuzione digitale e dei media pagati su più mercati fuori dai nostri uffici a Ginevra, Svizzera.
Il candidato ideale combina il pensiero strategico con l'eccellenza operativa, ha una profonda competenza nei media retribuiti e nel marketing delle prestazioni digitali, e comprende le sfumature del comportamento dei consumatori di lusso in un pubblico globale diverso.

Il tuo impatto

1.    Leadership dei media locali / Marketing
•    A seconda delle dimensioni e del personale dei mercati nel vostro campo di applicazione, agire come sia il piombo digitale locale media, piombo media locale o leader di marketing locale.
•    Assicurarsi che le campagne multimediali guidino la strategia del marchio e si allineino agli standard globali, riflettendo il comportamento del pubblico locale, i modelli di domanda stagionale, i requisiti linguistici e le sfumature culturali.
•    Collabora con i team di vendita e marketing locali per supportare obiettivi commerciali e commerciali specifici sul mercato, e con i team di marketing e media globali per garantire la coerenza strategica ed esecutiva del marchio.

2.    Consegna della campagna digitale
•    Condurre la consegna end-to-end di campagne di marketing digitale su più mercati, assicurando l'esecuzione tempestiva, la coerenza, con tutti i posizionamenti e gli adattamenti patrimoniali che soddisfano gli standard del marchio di lusso
•    Coordinate con team creativi, contenuti, CRM, ecommerce e digitali per garantire l'integrazione della campagna senza soluzione di continuità e l'allineamento del percorso del cliente.

3.    Strategia e performance dei media
•    Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie multimediali a pagamento locali su più mercati.
•    Gestisci le relazioni di agenzia locale, piattaforme e partner media.

4.    Analisi delle misurazioni e delle prestazioni

Possedere la misura integrata dei media attraverso l'imbuto di marketing. Monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni e ottimizzare gli investimenti per guidare la consapevolezza del marchio, la crescita dei ricavi, l'acquisizione dei clienti e le prenotazioni dirette, fornendo approfondimenti e raccomandazioni per il miglioramento continuo, inclusi report e presentazioni per la leadership senior.

5.    Leader & innovazione dei media

Proprio il piano di innovazione attraverso i canali. Identificare gli ultimi sviluppi del settore dei media, raccomandando test e imparare i piani per integrare le aree rilevanti per la strategia dei media di Explora.

6.    Costruisci l'alfabetizzazione dei media

Scambio della conoscenza dei media nei mercati di tutti i dipartimenti per migliorare le capacità di pianificazione dei media e l'eccellenza nella consegna.

7.    Gestione del bilancio

Possiede la pianificazione, la spesa e la gestione del budget dei media globali, inclusa la gestione agenzia/vendor

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Corso di laurea o master

- 15+ anni di ruoli lato client nei media globali e locali, tra cui pianificazione, ATL/BTL e gestione diretta dei media digitali

- Forte conoscenza di fabbricazione

- Comprensione dei media di lusso: conoscenza approfondita dei media offline e digitali, interdipendenze tra i media pagati, di proprietà e guadagnati, così come specifiche dei media di lusso

- Prove capacità di roll-up le maniche ed eseguire con eccellenza

- Tracciare il record di agenzie di gestione, piattaforme e partner multimediali e costruire partnership efficaci

- Pensatore critico strategico e innovativo.

- Strutturato, ben organizzato, orientato al dettaglio, e in grado di gestire più progetti, prosperando in un ambiente di avvio veloce e veloce.

- Collaborazione eccezionale e capacità di influenzare, con comprovata capacità di navigare in un'organizzazione di matrice. Efficacemente organizzare i team per fornire risultati aziendali.

- Prove competenze analitiche con competenza in strumenti e piattaforme multimediali

- Forte preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore lusso o lusso ospitalità / viaggio. Una passione personale per i viaggi di lusso e la mentalità globale.

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione, sia scritta che verbale. Fluente in inglese.

- Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria dei media in continua evoluzione.

Dein Zweck

Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorgestellt wird. Durch die Nutzung der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (derzeit vier in der Pipeline) auf eine völlig andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und entworfen, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis verändern und neu definieren und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht.

Eine aufregende Gelegenheit besteht für einen kommerziell betriebenen und digital fließenden Marketing & Media Manager, die Bereitstellung digitaler und kostenpflichtiger Medien in mehreren Märkten von unseren Büros in Genf, Schweiz, aus zu leiten.
Der ideale Kandidat kombiniert strategisches Denken mit operativer Exzellenz, verfügt über fundiertes Fachwissen im Bereich Paid Media und Digital Performance Marketing und versteht die Nuancen des Luxuskonsumverhaltens bei verschiedenen globalen Zielgruppen.

Ihre Wirkung

1.    Lokale Medien / Marketing Leadership
•    Abhängig von der Größe und der Besetzung der Märkte in Ihrem Bereich, handeln Sie entweder als lokaler Digital Media Lead, lokaler Media Lead oder lokaler Marketing Lead.
•    Stellen Sie sicher, dass Medienkampagnen die Markenstrategie vorantreiben und sich an globalen Standards orientieren, während sie das lokale Publikumsverhalten, saisonale Nachfragemuster, Sprachanforderungen und kulturelle Nuancen widerspiegeln.
•    Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Vertriebs- und Marketingteams zur Unterstützung marktspezifischer Geschäfts- und Geschäftsziele sowie mit globalen Marketing- und Medienteams zur Gewährleistung strategischer und exekutiver Markenkonsistenz.

2.    Digitale Kampagnenbereitstellung
•    Führen Sie die End-to-End-Bereitstellung digitaler Marketingkampagnen über mehrere Märkte hinweg und gewährleisten Sie eine zeitnahe Ausführung, Konsistenz, wobei alle Platzierungen und Asset-Anpassungen den Luxusmarkenstandards entsprechen
•    Koordinieren Sie sich mit Kreativ-, Content-, CRM-, E-Commerce- und digitalen Teams, um eine nahtlose Kampagnenintegration und Kundenreise-Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten.

3.    Paid Media Strategie und Performance
•    Entwickeln und implementieren Sie lokale Paid Media Strategien in mehreren Märkten.
•    Verwalten Sie lokale Agenturen, Plattformen und Medienpartnerbeziehungen.

4.    Messung und Leistungsanalyse

Besitzen Sie die integrierte Messung von Medien über den Marketing-Funnel. Überwachen und analysieren Sie die Leistung und optimieren Sie Investitionen, um Markenbekanntheit, Umsatzwachstum, Kundenakquisition und Direktbuchungen zu fördern, indem Sie Einblicke und Empfehlungen für kontinuierliche Verbesserungen liefern, einschließlich Berichten und Präsentationen für Führungskräfte.

5.    Media Thought Leadership & Innovation

Besitzen Sie den Innovationsplan über alle Kanäle hinweg. Identifizieren Sie die neuesten Entwicklungen in der Medienbranche und empfehlen Sie Test- & Lernpläne zur Integration der relevanten Bereiche in die Medienstrategie von Explora Journey.

6.    Medienkompetenz aufbauen

Ändern Sie das Medienwissen in abteilungsübergreifenden Märkten, um die Fähigkeiten der Medienplanung und die Exzellenz bei der Bereitstellung zu verbessern.

7.    Haushaltsführung

Eigentümer der globalen Medienbudgetplanung, -ausgaben und -verantwortung, einschließlich Agentur- / Verkäufermanagement

- 15+ Jahre Client Side Rollen in globalen und lokalen Medien, einschließlich Planung, ATL / BTL und direkt laufenden digitalen Medien

- Starkes Wissen

- Herausragendes Verständnis von Luxusmedien: fundierte Kenntnisse der Offline- und digitalen Medien, der Interdependenzen zwischen Paid, Owned und Earned Media sowie der Besonderheiten von Luxusmedien

- Bewährte Fähigkeit, Ihre Ärmel hochzukrempeln und mit Exzellenz auszuführen

- Erfolgsbilanz von Verwaltungsagenturen, Plattformen und Medienpartnern und Aufbau effektiver Partnerschaften

Ihre Essentials

- Strategischer und innovativer kritischer Denker.

- Strukturiert, gut organisiert, detailorientiert und in der Lage, mehrere Projekte zu verwalten, die in einer schnelllebigen Start-up-Umgebung gedeihen.

- Herausragende Zusammenarbeit und beeinflussende Fähigkeiten, mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, eine Matrixorganisation zu navigieren. Organisieren Sie effektiv Teams, um Geschäftsergebnisse zu liefern.

- Nachgewiesene analytische Fähigkeiten mit Kenntnissen in Medien-Tools und Plattformen

- Starke Präferenz für frühere Erfahrungen in der Luxus- oder Luxus-Hospitality / Reisebranche. Eine persönliche Leidenschaft für Luxusreisen und globale Denkweise.

- Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl schriftlich als auch verbal. fließend in Englisch.

- Leidenschaft und Neugier, sich kontinuierlich über die sich ständig weiterentwickelnde Medienbranche zu informieren.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

The objective of the role is to optimize DTC performance, identify and drive key levers, increase conversion rate to drive channel revenue, effectiveness and efficiency.
Optimize Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) performance by identifying and activating key growth levers that improve revenue generation across markets and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) sub-channels, conversion, channel effectiveness and operational and investment efficiency.

- Performance analysis: monitor and analyse performance against channel and commercial KPIs, providing channel-specific insights and recommendations by market to maximize revenue per B2C sub-channel (Web, Call Centre and Future Sales) and drive continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key KPIs.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by sub-channel by market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact channels.

- Develop attribution models to identify channel levers which drive revenue.

- Build and maintain B2C performance scorecards by market to monitor and optimize B2C channel performance, identifying drop-off points. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Partner with Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Centre and Future Sales to improve customer journeys, reduce friction, increase conversion, repeat and customer lifetime value.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in commercial analytics, business intelligence, DTC analytics or eCommerce performance.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of direct sales channels

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un talentuoso, esperto di analisi, un professionista strategico e altamente organizzato con un forte acume commerciale per unire il nostro nuovo marchio di viaggio di lusso Explora Journeys, con sede nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, in Svizzera.

Il tuo impatto

L'obiettivo del ruolo è quello di ottimizzare le prestazioni DTC, identificare e guidare le leve chiave, aumentare il tasso di conversione per guidare le entrate del canale, l'efficacia e l'efficienza.
Ottimizzare le prestazioni Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) identificando e attivando leve di crescita chiave che migliorano la generazione dei ricavi su mercati e sub-canale Business-to-Consumer (B2C), conversione, efficacia dei canali e efficienza operativa e di investimento.

- Analisi delle prestazioni: monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni contro i canali e i KPI commerciali, fornendo intuizioni e raccomandazioni specifiche del canale per il mercato per massimizzare i ricavi per il sub-canale B2C (Web, Call Centre e Future Sales) e guidare il miglioramento continuo. Proprio lo sviluppo, il monitoraggio e l'azione dei KPI chiave.

- Efficienza dell'azionamento, quantificazione ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA da sottocanale da mercato per ottimizzare continuamente gli investimenti. Raccomandare reinvestimenti verso canali di maggior impatto.

- Sviluppa modelli di attribuzione per identificare le leve del canale che guidano le entrate.

- Costruire e mantenere le schede di punteggio delle prestazioni B2C per mercato per monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni del canale B2C, identificare i punti di drop-off. Sia in Excel che in collaborazione con il team aziendale per renderlo disponibile negli strumenti self-serve (Power BI).

- Partner con Media, Digitale, Commerciale, Vendite, IT, Call Centre e Future Sales per migliorare i viaggi dei clienti, ridurre l'attrito, aumentare la conversione, ripetere e il valore della vita del cliente.

- Analisi competitiva: monitorare le condizioni di mercato, l'attività competitiva e le tendenze del settore per sostenere la pianificazione strategica e identificare le opportunità di differenziazione e crescita.

- Prepara presentazioni esecutive, con chiare raccomandazioni basate sui dati per supportare il processo decisionale strategico di leadership senior, sfruttando la visualizzazione dei dati stellari combinata con la profondità di insight.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 5+ anni di esperienza precedente in analisi commerciali, intelligenza aziendale, analisi DTC o prestazioni di eCommerce.

- Preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso / viaggio o agenzie di consulenza.

- Corso di laurea in Business, Economia, Finanza, Marketing, Commerciale o relativo campo (Master, MBA o equivalente esperienza preferita).

I tuoi essenziali

- Esperienza comprovata che supporta i dirigenti senior e prospera in un ambiente di avvio veloce, gestendo più priorità contemporaneamente.

- Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con la capacità di tradurre i dati complessi in insight aziendali attuabili.

- Eccezionale competenza in Excel e comoda manipolazione di dati di grandi dimensioni e mantenimento di grandi fogli di calcolo con alto livello di precisione

- Straordinarie competenze di PowerPoint e storytelling — in grado di creare presentazioni pulite, croccanti, ad alto impatto per il pubblico C-suite.

- Esperienza di lavoro con Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics o piattaforme simili, nonché strumenti di visualizzazione e BI come Tableau, Power BI, Looker o piattaforme simili.

- Conoscenza dei canali di vendita diretti

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale. Fluente in inglese.

- Passione e curiosità per conoscere continuamente l'industria del viaggio in continua evoluzione.

A Explora Journeys, stiamo ridefinindo i viaggi oceanici di lusso - dove la scoperta, il benessere, e un profondo rispetto per i mari si uniscono in armonia.
Cerchiamo professionisti appassionati che condividono la nostra visione di un modo più coinvolgente e trasformativo per scoprire le destinazioni più ispiranti del mondo dal mare.
Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

Dein Zweck

Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorgestellt wird. Durch die Nutzung der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (derzeit vier in der Pipeline) auf eine völlig andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und entworfen, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis verändern und neu definieren und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht.

Eine aufregende Gelegenheit besteht für einen talentierten, fachkundigen, strategischen und hoch organisierten Fachmann mit starkem kommerziellem Scharfsinn, sich unserer neu geschaffenen Luxusreisemarke Explora Journeys anzuschließen, die in unseren Büros in Genf, Schweiz, ansässig ist.

Ihre Wirkung

Das Ziel der Rolle ist es, die DTC-Leistung zu optimieren, Schlüsselhebel zu identifizieren und zu steuern, die Conversion-Rate zu erhöhen, um Kanaleinnahmen, Effektivität und Effizienz zu steigern.
Optimieren Sie die Direct-to-Consumer-Performance (DTC), indem Sie wichtige Wachstumshebel identifizieren und aktivieren, die die Umsatzgenerierung in allen Märkten und B2C-Subkanälen (Business-to-Consumer) sowie die Conversion-, Channel-Effektivität und die Betriebs- und Investitionseffizienz verbessern.

- Leistungsanalyse: Überwachung und Analyse der Leistung anhand von Channel- und kommerziellen KPIs, Bereitstellung kanalspezifischer Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen nach Markt, um den Umsatz pro B2C-Subkanal (Web, Call Center und Future Sales) zu maximieren und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben. Eigenständig für die Entwicklung, Verfolgung und Aktionierung wichtiger KPIs.

- Steigerung der Effizienz durch Quantifizierung von ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA nach Subkanal nach Markt, um die Investitionen kontinuierlich zu optimieren. Empfehlen Sie Reinvestitionen in Richtung der höchsten Auswirkungen Kanäle.

- Entwicklung von Attributionsmodellen zur Identifizierung von Kanalhebeln, die den Umsatz steigern.

- Erstellen und pflegen Sie B2C Performance Scorecards nach Markt, um die B2C Channel Performance zu überwachen und zu optimieren und so Drop-Off-Punkte zu identifizieren. Sowohl auf Excel als auch in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Unternehmensteam, um es in Self-Service-Tools (Power BI) verfügbar zu machen.

- Partnerschaft mit Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Center und Future Sales, um Customer Journeys zu verbessern, Reibungen zu reduzieren, Conversion, Repeat und Customer Lifetime Value zu erhöhen.

- Wettbewerbsanalyse: Überwachung von Marktbedingungen, Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und Branchentrends zur Unterstützung der strategischen Planung und Identifizierung von Differenzierungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten.

- Bereiten Sie führungsbereite Präsentationen mit klaren datenbasierten Empfehlungen vor, um die strategische Entscheidungsfindung in der Geschäftsleitung zu unterstützen, indem Sie die Visualisierung stellarer Daten mit tiefen Einblicken kombinieren.

Deine Reise bisher

- 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Commercial Analytics, Business Intelligence, DTC Analytics oder E-Commerce Performance.

- Präferenz für vorherige Erfahrungen in der Luxus-Hospitality / Reisebranche oder Beratungsagenturen.

- Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial oder verwandten Bereichen (Masters, MBA oder gleichwertige Erfahrung bevorzugt).

Ihre Essentials

- Bewährte Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Führungskräften und in einer schnelllebigen Start-up-Umgebung, in der mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig verwaltet werden.

- Ausgezeichnete analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Daten in umsetzbare Geschäftserkenntnisse zu übersetzen.

- Sehr kompetent in Excel und bequemes Manipulieren großer Datensätze und Pflege großer Tabellenkalkulationen mit hoher Genauigkeit

- Hervorragende PowerPoint- und Storytelling-Fähigkeiten - in der Lage, saubere, klare und wirkungsvolle Präsentationen für das C-Suite-Publikum zu erstellen.

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics oder ähnlichen Plattformen sowie BI- und Visualisierungstools wie Tableau, Power BI, Looker oder ähnlichen Plattformen.

- Kenntnis der Direktverkaufskanäle

- Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. fließend in Englisch.

- Leidenschaft und Neugier, sich ständig über die sich ständig weiterentwickelnde Reisebranche zu informieren.

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Brand & Product
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

Part of the global Marketing team and reporting directly to the Brand Director, this role plays a central role in safeguarding, shaping and activating the Explora Journeys brand across all touchpoints, with a particular focus on brand campaigns, the fleet and new brand developments.

Based at our headquarters in Geneva, this role sits at the intersection of brand strategy, product storytelling, and execution, working closely with Product, Design, Hotel Operations, Commercial, PR, Media, and Digital teams to bring the brand to life with clarity, consistency and emotional depth, across markets.

Your Impact

Brand Management & Governance

- Act as a core guardian of the Explora Journeys brand, supporting the Brand Director in the day to day management, development, and evolution of the brand.

- Ensure consistent application of brand identity, tone of voice, messaging, and visual language across all touchpoints, channels, and guest journeys.

- Lead the development, evolution and maintenance of brand guidelines, frameworks, and master toolkits, ensuring relevance, clarity, and scalability globally.

- Monitor brand execution across markets and partners, proactively identifying inconsistencies and working collaboratively with stakeholders to safeguard luxury and hospitality standards.

- Contribute to brand strategy initiatives, brand evolution projects, and internal brand education, strengthening brand understanding and alignment across the organisation.

Campaigns, Content & Brand Activation

- Lead the development and delivery of master brand and product campaigns, in line with brand strategy and commercial priorities.

- Oversee the creation of hero brand and product assets, including key visuals, copy frameworks, brochures, photography, and videography.

- Work closely with Media, Digital, and PR teams to ensure a coherent  and premium brand expression across paid, owned, and earned channels.

- Manage and curate brand, product and fleet content within DAM and PIM systems, ensuring accuracy, ease of use and global market adoption.

Product Marketing – Fleet & Onboard Experience

- Own and articulate the brand and product narrative for the Explora Journeys fleet, translating ship design, onboard experiences and service philosophy into compelling, clear, and guest-centric storytelling.

- Act as a key brand partner to Product, New Builds and Hotel Operations teams, supporting projects throughout the ship lifecycle; from early concept through delivery, launch and in-service evolution.

- Define and activate ship level propositions and concepts, onboard experiences, suite concepts, culinary, wellness and retail pillars, and service rituals.

- Ensure alignment between the onboard guest experience and the brand promise communicated to market.

Launch & Go to Market Coordination

- Support brand and product readiness for new brand initiatives, campaigns, ship launches, major milestones, and onboard innovations.

- Develop master launch toolkits to equip channels, markets, Sales, and PR with clear narratives, positioning and assets.

- Ensure consistency, clarity and brand alignment across all internal and external communications related to brand, fleet and product evolution.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

- Act as a trusted brand partner across functions, fostering alignment between brand, product, commercial, and operational teams

- Coordinate budgets, suppliers, forecasting, purchase orders, and invoicing related to brand initiatives.

- Balance strategic brand thinking with hands on execution in a fast paced environment.

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Marketing, Brand Management, Product Marketing, or a related field.

- 8+ years’ experience in brand management and campaign building.

- Prior experience within luxury, premium or high-end travel, hospitality or consumer brands strongly preferred.

- Proven experience operating in a global headquarters environment, managing brand frameworks and master assets across markets.

- Experience managing agencies and external creative partners.

Your Essentials

- Exposure to product marketing and physical experience‑based products (ships, hotels, resorts, or complex premium environments highly desirable).

- Strong creative sensibility combined with operational rigour, attention to detail and stakeholder management skills.

- Comfortable moving between strategic brand thinking and detailed execution.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a strong advantage.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. You will spearhead our testing and insights strategy to maximize conversion rates, booking volumes and revenue per visitor, while building a best-in-class experimentation practice that delivers sustainable competitive advantage. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

Your Impact

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

• Drive strategic initiatives within the direct channel, ensuring a data-driven approach to lead generation, audience segmentation, and customer journey optimization to improve conversion and engagement.

• Develop deep customer journey insights through advanced analytics, identifying key friction points and opportunities to enhance the user experience and drive higher booking values.

• Perform advanced digital segmentation analyses to uncover high-value customer segments and personalization opportunities across the conversion funnel.

• Establish robust measurement frameworks to quantify the commercial impact of optimization initiatives, including test design, revenue forecasting, and post-implementation analysis.

• Develop comprehensive performance dashboards that combine testing results, customer behavior metrics, and commercial KPIs to guide conversion rate optimization.

• Drive innovation in personalization and optimization strategies to maximize direct channel contribution using the newly adopted tools (Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Real-time CDP).

• Develop testing frameworks that balance quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Your Journey so far

• Degree in business, marketing, analytics, or a related field, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Proven track record of leveraging D2C data insights to shape marketing and product strategies, particularly in booking funnel optimization.

• Hands-on experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target.

Your Essentials

• Expertise in web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics and AEP.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to distill complex data into actionable business strategies.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence decision-making.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, managing multiple initiatives simultaneously.

• EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

• Laurea in business, marketing, analisi o un campo relativo, con 5 anni di esperienza rilevante.
• Provato track record di sfruttare intuizioni di dati D2C per modellare le strategie di marketing e di prodotto, in particolare nella prenotazione di ottimizzazione deimbuti.
• Esperienza pratica con strumenti di test A/B come Adobe Target. I tuoi essenziali
• Esperienza nelle piattaforme di analisi web come Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics e AEP.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente tra i team e influenzare il processo decisionale.
• Capacità di prosperare in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione, gestendo più iniziative contemporaneamente.

Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only.
The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization.
For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction.
For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles.
Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations.

Your Impact

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees.

- Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore.

- Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as:

- guest experience excellence

- safety and compliance

- operational performance

- leadership effectiveness

- digital and business transformation

- Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments.

- Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet.

- Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence.

- Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments.

- Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders.

- Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions.

- Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards.

Shore-Based Learning & Development

- Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions.

- Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as:

- commercial capabilities

- digital transformation

- operational excellence

- guest-centric culture

- Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

- Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only)

- Define and implement the company’s global talent management strategy for shore-based employees.

- Lead processes for:

- talent identification and talent reviews

- succession planning for critical leadership roles

- high-potential development programs

- leadership pipeline development

- career development frameworks

- Partner with executive leadership and HR Business Partners to ensure strong succession pipelines for key corporate and operational leadership positions ashore.

- Embed talent management practices into performance management and leadership development frameworks.

Leadership Development

- Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations.

- Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture.

- Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as:

- people leadership

- operational decision-making

- service excellence

- innovation and continuous improvement

- cross-cultural leadership

Your Journey so far

Education

- Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Talent Management, or Organizational Development.

- Significant experience designing and implementing global learning strategies for large, international workforces.

- Proven experience leading talent management and succession planning programs for corporate leadership populations.

- Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred.

- Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments.

Key Competences

- Strategic Learning & Capability Development

- Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate)

- Service Excellence & Hospitality Culture

- Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership

- Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence

- Organizational Development

- Learning Technology & Digital Learning

Your Essentials

- Fluency in English is required; Italian, French, German or other European languages are a plus.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Der Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) und Talent Management (Ashore) ist dafür verantwortlich, die globale Strategie für Lernen und Entwicklung sowohl für Mitarbeiter an Bord als auch an Land zu definieren und zu leiten, während er Talent Management und Nachfolgeplanung nur für an Land ansässige Bevölkerungen überwacht.
Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass das Unternehmen die Fähigkeiten entwickelt, die erforderlich sind, um außergewöhnliche Gästeerlebnisse, operative Exzellenz und eine starke Führungsrolle in einer globalen Belegschaft zu bieten, darunter Tausende von Schiffsbesatzungen und eine vielfältige Organisation an Land.
Für Mitarbeiter an Bord konzentriert sich die Rolle auf den Aufbau von erstklassigen Betriebs- und Servicefähigkeiten durch strukturierte Schulungen, Führungsentwicklung und Karriereentwicklungsrahmen, die die Leistung der Flotte und die Gästezufriedenheit unterstützen.

- Gasterlebnis Exzellenz

- Sicherheit und Einhaltung

- Betriebsleistung

- Führungswirksamkeit

- Digitale und Business Transformation

- sécurité et conformité

- performance opérationnelle

- efficacité de la direction

- transformation numérique et des entreprises

- Diriger la conception et la prestation de la stratégie globale d'apprentissage et de développement à bord des navires dans l'ensemble de la flotte.

- Assurer l'uniformité des normes de formation dans l'ensemble de la flotte tout en tenant compte des réalités opérationnelles des environnements de bord.

- Superviser les programmes de perfectionnement pour les rôles clés à bord des navires, y compris les programmes de supervision et de perfectionnement de la gestion pour les futurs dirigeants à bord.

- Assurer l'alignement sur toutes les exigences en matière de formation réglementaire maritime et les normes de sécurité.

Apprentissage et développement à terre

- Diriger la conception et la mise en oeuvre de programmes d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour les employés à terre dans l'ensemble des fonctions ministérielles et opérationnelles.

- capacités commerciales

- transformation numérique

- excellence opérationnelle

- Culture centrée sur les invités

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Mobile App Product Specialist to join our Business Innovation team at MSC Cruises Headquarters in Geneva. This role is designed for a data-driven professional with a strong commercial acumen, an analytical mindset, and a passion for optimizing mobile user journeys. The successful candidate will explore in-app behaviors, remove friction in the sales funnel, and drive product-led initiatives to maximize conversion rates and shape the future of digital guest experiences across the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

Your Impact

- Analyze the MSC for Me in-app user journey and behavior to identify bottlenecks, proposing and validating product initiatives that optimize the sales funnel and boost in-app conversion rates.

- Collaborate with Product, Tech, and UX/UI cross-functional teams to design and implement features that drive organic user acquisition and increase cross-selling/up-selling opportunities for the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Implement and optimize the in-app position of commercial offerings (working closing with Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) to maximize visibility and sales conversions specifically for mobile users.

- Use advanced product analytics tools and data visualization (Power BI) to track sales performance, user activation rates, and drop-offs into the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Act as a bridge between the Onboard Revenues Commercial department and the Tech/Development teams, translating revenue goals into clear digital product requirements to enhance the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Drive MSC for Me  channel-led acquisition by refining native in-app features—such as frictionless guest-to-registered user flows, invite-a-friend mechanisms, and seamless app sharing—to grow the user base.

- Conduct A/B testing on MSC for Me  in-app sales flows, checkout processes, and subscription models to continuously improve operational efficiency and revenue generation.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing Management, Digital or a related field.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills with 3 to 5 years of proven experience in digital sales, product growth, or digital business development, with a strict focus on mobile applications.

- Hands-on experience with app analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and data manipulation/visualization tools (Power BI, SQL; Python is a plus).

- Familiarity with agile methodologies and ability to work side-by-side with developers and product managers in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate data-driven insights into actionable business and product recommendations.

- Creative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, capable of driving "Product-Led Growth" rather than relying on traditional marketing spend.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of mobile user behavior, digital sales funnels, and product-centric acquisition ecosystems.

- Strong business acumen with a focus on maximizing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and removing friction from the mobile buying experience.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.

VISA REQUIREMENTS (if any) :

- Right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il tuo impatto

- Analizza il percorso e il comportamento dell'utente MSC per Me in-app per identificare i colli di bottiglia, proponendo e convalidando iniziative di prodotto che ottimizzano l'imbuto di vendita e aumentano i tassi di conversione in-app.

- Collabora con i team interfunzionali di Prodotto, Tech e UX/UI per progettare e implementare funzionalità che favoriscano l'acquisizione di utenti organici e aumentano le opportunità di cross-selling/up-selling per l'ecosistema digitale MSC for Me.

- Implementare e ottimizzare la posizione in-app delle offerte commerciali (chiusura di lavoro con Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) per massimizzare la visibilità e le conversioni di vendita specificamente per gli utenti mobili.

- Utilizza strumenti avanzati di analisi dei prodotti e visualizzazione dei dati (Power BI) per monitorare le prestazioni di vendita, i tassi di attivazione degli utenti e i drop-off nell'ecosistema digitale MSC for Me.

- Agire come un ponte tra il reparto commerciale Onboard Revenues e i team Tech/Development, traducendo gli obiettivi di fatturato in requisiti di prodotto digitali chiari per migliorare l'ecosistema digitale MSC per Me.

- Guida l'acquisizione guidata da MSC per Me tramite la raffinazione di funzioni in-app native, come flussi di utenti senza attrito, meccanismi di invito-a-amico e condivisione di app senza fili, per aumentare la base dell'utente.

- Condurre test A/B su MSC per Me flussi di vendita, processi di checkout e modelli di abbonamento per migliorare continuamente l'efficienza operativa e la generazione di ricavi.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Laurea o master in Business Administration, Economia, Marketing Management, Digital o un campo relativo.

- Forte capacità commerciali e analitiche con 3 a 5 anni di comprovata esperienza nelle vendite digitali, nella crescita del prodotto o nello sviluppo aziendale digitale, con un focus rigoroso sulle applicazioni mobili.

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.

• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves.
